cases.case_label: 5'-truncated L1 inserted at the 3' end of DMD exon 44 causing exon 44 skipping
cases.mechanism_detail: A 606-608 bp 5'-truncated L1, in the inverse-complement orientation, inserted zero to two bases upstream of the 3' end of exon 44 with loss of two to four exonic bases. RT-PCR of lymphocyte transcript showed exon 43 joined directly to exon 45, i.e. exon 44 skipping. The insertion was absent in the maternal grandparents, so it arose in the mother.
cases.quote: Exon 44 of the transcript was thus shown to be skipped during splicing.
